featured_reviews.name: Ritendra Mishra
featured_reviews.review_text: Several authentic Maharashtrian lunch homes have cropped up recently in Virar west serving meals for as low as 35 bucks with good taste and quantity. This place is one of them. Veg and non-vegetarian fare available here, although not every day. Thursday and Saturday non-vegetarian is not available. I tried the thali here, which cost 70 bucks plus 5 bucks extra for parcel. Food was ok. Quantity too was passable. Overall, I would say there are better options in terms of quantity, quality, and pricing in Virar west if you want to have a meal.
